item.title: Moving Gitea from FreeBSD to Linux
item.description: I’ve been using TrueNAS for a number of years, from when it was FreeBSD-based to now that it’s Linux-based. Right now I use them both: TrueNAS Core (FreeBD) and TrueNAS Scale (Linux). The TrueNAS Scale box has been mostly for fiddling with containers, while the TrueNAS Core box is the heavy lifter: all of my Carbon Copy Cloner backups go there, and there are FreeBSD jails running my Plex server as weill as my Gitea server.
